record.clinical_notes: Primi, 39 wks POG, admitted in early labour. Labour augmented; CTG showed recurrent late decelerations, FHR 100-110 bpm - fetal distress. Non-reassuring NST + failure to progress -> emergency LSCS. Live female baby delivered, good Apgar, no resuscitation needed. EBL within normal limits, uterus well contracted post-delivery. Uneventful post-op course, ambulated D1, breastfeeding established. Mother-baby dyad discharged D3, stable, postnatal f/u and wound care advised.
